input.quote: Each invoice submitted by Contractor will provide supporting detail for the Services invoiced, including, to the extent applicable to a particular engagement, the dates of Services and hours worked at the applicable rate by Statement of Work.
input.rationale: Searches for "audit", "inspect", "verif" and "records" return no audit, inspection or usage-verification right exercisable against Clear Capital. Section 3 (compensation) runs one way only — Contractor must supply invoice-level supporting detail to us — and Section 4 grants us a perpetual license to Contractor's Information with no reporting, self-certification or usage-audit condition. Section 1 addresses only Contractor's access to Company systems under our own security policies, not any Contractor right of access for verification purposes. There is therefore nothing binding us on frequency, notice, cost allocation or system access, which is better than the preferred position; the absence operates entirely in our favour and no redline is warranted. Should a Statement of Work later introduce a verification or records-inspection right, we would apply the preferred limits (annual, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, Vendor cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, no direct system access).
